rules.slot: 1 Keepsake slot per actor; equipping a Keepsake is free out of battle and costs the actor's turn in battle.
rules.cost: sp + lumen (Mio, others pay lumen as SP x1.5? no: lumen pool is Mio's; non-Mio summoners pay lumen cost from the party pool = Mio's Lumen, Mio must be alive)
rules.bossMult: summons deal tier-scaled damage to bosses: T1 x1.0, T2 x0.9, T3 x0.8, T4 x0.7

sm_wellkeeper.name: Wellkeeper's Mercy
sm_wellkeeper.desc: Heal the party 45% max HP, Regen 3 turns, cure Burn/Chill/Wilt.

obtain.how: Story gift: the Well Spirit after the Bell-Keeper is laid to rest (Ch2).

sm_wellkeeper.story: The first time the player is helped rather than fighting alone.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses
water ring rises under each ally

sm_oto.name: Oto Leads the Way
sm_oto.desc: Party Veiled 3 turns + Nimble 3 turns; all enemies Mood +10; the next Flee is guaranteed.

obtain.how: Quest: return Oto to the old woman at the Crossing (Ch3).

sm_oto.story: A guide dog who is also the game's hint system.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_willow.name: Weeping Bough
sm_willow.desc: Bloom 0.9 on all enemies; 50% Wilt, 40% Dazed; Mood +15.

obtain.how: Resolve the Willow Mother peacefully (Calm + Send or Invite); she leaves the Sprig (Ch3).

sm_willow.story: Her grief becomes a gentle ward.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_gonbei.name: Grand Parade
sm_gonbei.desc: Gale 1.5 on all enemies; party Echoing 3 turns; +20% gold this battle.

obtain.how: Parley the Parade Master with Echo ≥2 (or win); the ticket stays as his Keepsake (Ch4).

sm_gonbei.story: Festival noise as power: Echo as social energy.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_amabie.name: Amabie's Foretelling
sm_amabie.desc: Reveal the next 2 enemy telegraphs, party Veiled 3 turns, cure all ailments (not Hollow Touch).

obtain.how: Bond Lv5 with Amabie (Invite in the Moonlit Canals, 15 offerings) → Keepsake appears (Ch4+).

sm_amabie.story: Optional: the prophet gives her prophecy to the player.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_kettle.name: Hearth Feast
sm_kettle.desc: Heal party 25% max HP, restore 15 SP each, Regen 3 turns, cure Burn.

obtain.how: Bond Lv3 with Hearth Brownie plus the "Feed the Hearth" side quest (Ch4); Keepsake appears.

sm_kettle.story: A warm kitchen spirit — recoup SP when you can't afford potions.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_anvil.name: Hundred-Year Strike
sm_anvil.desc: Flame 3.4 on one enemy (best of ATK/MAT); 60% Burn, 30% Stun; 2 VP damage.

obtain.how: Resolve the Hundred-Year Anvil peacefully or by victory; Anvil Heart drops (Ch5).

sm_anvil.story: Daigo's master gives one last strike.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_tengu.name: Hundred-Step Flurry
sm_tengu.desc: 4 random Gale hits of 0.9 (best stat); 30% Blind each; summoner Nimble 3 turns.

obtain.how: Bond Lv5 with Tengu Crow (or defeat the Hundred-Step Tengu on the optional Stair); Keepsake appears (Ch6).

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_sachi.name: Sachi's Lantern
sm_sachi.desc: Revive fallen allies at 50% HP, party Protected 3 turns, cure all ailments (incl. Fading); Mio +20 Lumen.

obtain.how: Story: Ch6 flashback — Sachi gives the Hearth shard; Keepsake unlocks after the Rekindled Lantern.

sm_sachi.story: The grandmother's love as a heavy-hitting rescue.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_archive.name: Open the Index
sm_archive.desc: Reveal both-realm weaknesses, Marked on all enemies (next hit crit), 2 VP damage to all.

obtain.how: Calm or Send the Archive Echo; Archive Page stays as a Keepsake (Ch6).

sm_archive.story: The Archive helps once you give it a name.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_guardian.name: Stillness
sm_guardian.desc: All enemies 70% Stun (bosses 35%); party takes x0.75 damage for 2 turns (Garden Calm).

obtain.how: Calm the Garden Guardian; the pebble remains (Ch7).

sm_guardian.story: Stillness as comfort, not as a trap.

anim.note: Spirit portrait slides in from the right; screen dims 30%; keepsake icon pulses

sm_lantern_night.name: Procession of Lanterns
sm_lantern_night.desc: Lumen 3.0 on all enemies in both realms (Far multiplier always applies); heal party 40% and cure all ailments. Needs 18+ Name Fragments.

obtain.how: Ch8: Name Fragments ≥ 18 in the Archive Heart; Mio lights the lantern.

sm_lantern_night.story: Every Sent soul walks beside you.
